title: aniflow source-entry music-video recipe configuration v1
description: Closed one-command source entry: bounded original-frame extraction followed by the existing fixed indexed recipe. Extraction, repair, upscale and assembly keep their existing configuration owners. Target-resolution neural pins are retained as intent but their files are required only after accepted extraction establishes that neural execution is necessary. Rust validates cross-field compatibility and limits caller JSON to 131072 bytes.
